asus.title: Revenue from Contracts with Customers
asus.summary: Establishes a single, comprehensive revenue recognition model for all contracts with customers, replacing industry-specific guidance.

asus.title: Leases
asus.summary: Requires lessees to recognize right-of-use assets and lease liabilities on the balance sheet for most leases.

asus.title: Financial Instruments - Credit Losses: Measurement of Credit Losses on Financial Instruments (CECL)
asus.summary: Replaces the incurred loss model with a current expected credit losses (CECL) model for financial assets measured at amortized cost.

asus.title: Debt - Debt with Conversion and Other Options and Derivatives and Hedging - Contracts in Entity's Own Equity
asus.summary: Simplifies accounting for convertible instruments and the derivatives scope exception for contracts in an entity's own equity.

asus.title: Fair Value Measurement of Equity Securities Subject to Contractual Sale Restrictions
asus.summary: Clarifies that a contractual restriction on the sale of an equity security is not considered in measuring fair value.

asus.title: Segment Reporting: Improvements to Reportable Segment Disclosures
asus.summary: Requires enhanced disclosures about significant segment expenses, primarily through interim and annual disclosure requirements.

asus.title: Income Taxes: Improvements to Income Tax Disclosures
asus.summary: Requires disaggregated disclosure of the effective tax rate reconciliation and income taxes paid by jurisdiction.

asus.title: Income Statement - Reporting Comprehensive Income - Expense Disaggregation Disclosures (DISE)
asus.summary: Requires disaggregation of certain income statement expense captions into specified natural expense categories in the notes.

tasks.title: Inventory current tax rate reconciliation disclosures
tasks.description: Review existing effective tax rate reconciliation footnote and identify gaps against the new disaggregation categories.

tasks.title: Map natural expense categories to GL accounts
tasks.description: Build a crosswalk from existing chart of accounts to the DISE required natural expense categories.
